opening.argument: The speaker expressly tells viewers to sign up through a referral link, promises that both parties will receive $10, and directs them to buy $100 of Bitcoin so the speaker receives a referral reward. These are concrete recruitment requests tied to the speaker’s financial benefit. The speaker then asks viewers to send that Bitcoin, while the description supplies a Bitcoin address and the closing card pairs “SUBSCRIBE AND SEND BITCOIN” with a QR code. Together, these appeals establish a referral-driven scam promotion that also solicits Bitcoin transfers. The Coinbase walkthrough and mocking accusations against the platform do not negate those explicit referral and transfer requests.
